mission: Convert raw consumer tennis video into a traceable perceptual-causal coaching explanation. Detection, measurement, diagnosis, coaching and rendering are separate contracts.
non_negotiables: Do not begin with fault labels. Begin with events, tracks, observables and context.
Preserve time-series evidence; a stroke is a movement through time, not a collection of frozen poses.
Every derived claim must name its evidence IDs, confidence and comparison basis.
Prefer within-player good-vs-poor rep contrasts to generic professional geometry when enough comparable reps exist.
Locate the earliest meaningful divergence that plausibly explains later symptoms.
Treat adaptation to ball context as intelligence, not inconsistency.
If the camera cannot support a claim, suppress the claim rather than fill the gap with language-model inference.
The player report is a teaching product; the coach/debug report is an evidence product.

stages.purpose: Determine whether the clip can support analysis before any coaching is attempted.
Build the coordinate system used by later measurements.
Track the objects whose interaction defines a tennis stroke.
Find individual stroke attempts and group them into rallies/context windows.
Timestamp biomechanically meaningful events using fused evidence rather than a single detector.
Describe the problem the player was solving on this ball.
Create normalized metric traces and event-window summaries.
Transform raw metrics into coaching constructs such as timing reserve, spacing, sequencing, stability and recovery.
Find where weaker reps first separate from the player's stronger comparable reps.
Generate and test root-cause, contributor, compensation and symptom hypotheses.
Choose the smallest set of high-value coaching insights.
Translate each selected insight into an understandable visual sentence.
Prevent unsupported, contradictory, repetitive or overloaded feedback.

three_products.player: 1 strength + 1 primary correction + optional 1 secondary; visual first; few numbers; one cue.
three_products.advanced_player: same thesis with timing/spacing/sequence evidence and self-best comparison.
three_products.coach: full event timeline, metric traces, alternative hypotheses, uncertainty and raw evidence.
